test_case.test_name: ADDDC buddy-rank out-of-region second bank-VLS allocation
test_case.purpose: Prove a threshold on the current buddy rank in an unprotected bank preserves the first region and creates the approved second bank VLS.
required_package: Proof DIMM1/rank0/subchannel0 bank0 is outside region
Dedicated SUT, SMM/OOB recovery and rollback
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator verifies predecessor and chip-select decode, proves bank0 is outside the protected bank1 region, applies exact mask and two CEs, confirms threshold, executes go once, verifies original region unchanged, approved second region and cleared counter, then restores settings and validates health.
test_case.expected_result: The buddy-rank out-of-region threshold retains the first bank VLS, creates the exact second region, clears bookkeeping and leaves the SUT healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact buddy/outside-bank mapping, two CEs, threshold, preserved first/approved second regions, counter clear and restoration. Reverse allocation, wrong bank, first-region mutation or instability fails/blocks.
safety_gate: Critical injection approval on isolated SUT.
Do not inject without predecessor/CS/bank proof.
Exactly two CEs; stop on wrong first event.
No retry, reboot or inferred allocation.
expected_evidence: Before/after two-region table and counter clear
test_case.recovery: On wrong region, reverse allocation or hang, preserve state and use approved OOB recovery without more injection; restore ADDDC/threshold settings and verify memory/spare topology.
